source_to_pmus_price_delta.note: L5's price minus our own touch, in dollars; positive means his price is above our bid

l5_actual_behaviour.sells_note: L5's BTC15m corpus contains ZERO sells; a nonzero count here is news, not a translation artefact

mirror_raw_shadow_economics_q1.liquidity_rewards_why: eligibility and allocation not established, so counted at zero
mirror_raw_shadow_economics_q1.label: SHADOW. No order existed.
mirror_raw_shadow_economics_q1.ASSUMPTION: MIRROR_RAW advances its inventory on every action that was MAKER_COPYABLE at receipt. That is an assumption -- that we could have rested at L5's price AND been filled as he was -- not evidence. No PMUS fill has been observed, and the public book cannot supply one. Every pair and P&L figure on this line inherits that assumption and none of it is realized.
mirror_raw_shadow_economics_q1.residual_note: deliberately unmarked: its value is a settlement outcome and L5's own residual line is negative
mirror_raw_shadow_economics_q1.rebate_note: an accrual under the same assumption, not income

clone_model.note: CLONE_MODEL advances inventory only on fill evidence, and the public book supplies none, so it stays at OPEN by construction. That is a limit of the FEED, not a finding about the model.

interaction_evidence.why: no authenticated PMUS trade tape yet; the three richer classes are structurally unreachable and their absence is not evidence of absence
